models.expect: Takes a scoped task from the main agent and returns in seconds. Reads, renames, small edits and single-file changes. Not for work that needs many turns: it is unreliable past the point where a task stops being focused. The OptiQ build is chosen over the plain 4-bit because the plain one produced a roughly 200-call runaway tool loop in both passes at the 36 GB memory cap.
